description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to color values, primarily to be used for UI elements in a dashboard. It includes functions for generating deterministic pastel HSL colors from arbitrary strings and for mapping specific statuses to a theme palette, ensuring consistent coloring across dark backgrounds.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Generates a deterministic pastel-like HSL color from an input string, producing distinct hues for different strings while maintaining saturation and lightness suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a color from the provided theme tokens, or falls back to a deterministic color if the status is unrecognized. It caters to common statuses like processing, success, failed, and unknown.
